# C-BIOS MSX1 firmware

C-BIOS 0.29, distributed with openMSX (Contrib/cbios).
Source: https://github.com/openMSX/openMSX/tree/e8130bc3e3d132c0934467f0005af994b86f9fee/Contrib/cbios
Copyright, redistribution conditions and disclaimer: LICENSE.txt.
Main NTSC/PAL and Logo are embedded; no MSX2 sub-ROM or BASIC interpreter.
Regenerate the C++ header with `python3 tools/embed_cbios.py`.
